questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street. It is a regulation sign that drivers must obey.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, a right turn is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully and be prepared.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for cattle that may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means parking is not allowed at any time. Drivers must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. If traffic is clear, you may proceed without stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing where the road dips steeply to meet the tracks. The underside of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black symbols or words.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you can only park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are approaching railroad tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that lanes are changing direction. Follow the new lane path ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means large trucks are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign tells you to follow a detour around roadwork. Construction areas are dangerous for both drivers and workers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles frequently cross or travel next to the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery. Slow down in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions carefully. Flaggers help direct traffic through construction zones safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. Prepare for two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic signals where turning right on a red light is not allowed. You must wait for a green light to turn.
